_comment: Test fixture: Hollister $500 cart scenario for stacking engine validation
description: User has a $500 cart at Hollister with a 10% voucher (HCOFALL10) that requires $50 minimum. Tests basic percentage discount application.

recommended_card.name: US Bank Cash+ (DEMO)
recommended_card.reason: 5% cashback on Department Stores (MCC 5651 - Family Clothing)

expected_result.explanation: Applied HCOFALL10 for 10% off ($50.00 savings). Use US Bank Cash+ for 5% cashback ($22.50). Total savings: $72.50 (14.5%).

validation_rules: HCOFALL10 should be selected (only applicable Hollister reward)
Min spend $50 is satisfied by $500 cart
No max_discount cap, so full 10% applies
Exclusions (Gift Cards, Clearance) don't apply to cart items
US Bank Cash+ gives 5% on MCC 5651 (clothing stores)
Reward is not stackable, but only one Hollister reward exists
